description: The dataset supplies concentrations of metals in domestic wastewater with corresponding thermodynamic rarity values. It is explicitly supplementary to the industrial metabolic-pathway platform paper and forms a documented material-recovery information source. A single DOCX document is listed. The native metadata do not specify metal names, concentration units, observation locations, sample counts or uncertainty. These fields remain unknown, and no machine-readable table structure is claimed. The source documents a water quality treatment or recovery study. The source authors provide this description through Zenodo, whose deposit declares CC BY 4.0 and public document access. Geographic and temporal coverage remain limited to the cases or observations explicitly described. Only metadata and file descriptors were reviewed; no document, measurements, model archive or code was read. Related components retain their source identities and uncertain experimental overlap.
